stem:
Scientists have invented a way of producing food by artificial photosynthesis.

- Solar panels convert sunlight energy into electricity.
- The electricity powers an electrolysis reaction between carbon dioxide gas and water to form the organic product acetate.
- The single-celled alga Chlamydomonas, a protoctist, can use acetate to grow and reproduce in the dark, instead of photosynthesising in the light.
- The algae can be processed to make a food product.

Fig. 4.1 shows an outline of the artificial photosynthesis process.
